title: If "Kali" Is Caught: After Suvendu Adhikari Remark, Ex-Mayor's Aide Arrested
summary: "We don't know what has happened inside the Kolkata Municipal Corporation. If Kali is caught, all information will come out," Suvendu Adhikari said hours after the Kolkata warehouse collapse
